description: Synthetic sesslint.adapters.metadata parity (has_semantic_fields and UnknownMetadataTracker flush modes).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-metadata-finding-fingerprint: UnknownMetadataTracker.findings on a non-empty group buffer calls make_finding, which needs sesslint.determinism.canonical_json_bytes. Rust stops at the missing fingerprint codec and does not return Finding objects. The harness drives the tracker and checks empty_ok, finding_error before the codec, or gap_fingerprint. Pin snapshots of _groups stay in the vector and are not asserted, because those fields are private.
